name: Lucky Stars
source:
You’ve become the manager of a rock band of furry bad boys called Lucky. They’re notorious for being difficult to work with. Can you handle them?

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian app[/url]]
translation:
你成了一支名叫Lucky的摇滚乐队的经纪人。这群兽人坏小子出了名地难伺候。你能管得住他们吗？
